name: openpalm
description: OpenPalm CLI — install and manage a self-hosted OpenPalm stack

scripts.build: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/openpalm-cli
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/openpalm-cli-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/openpalm-cli-linux-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/openpalm-cli-darwin-x64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/openpalm-cli-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:windows-x64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/openpalm-cli-windows-x64.exe
